blind.description: A stylized, hand-painted wooden concert harp. It consists of a vertical fluted column topped with a circular capital, an arched neck with carved filigree, a wedge-shaped reddish-brown soundbox with gold filigree corner trim, and a planar interior section painted with vertical stripes to represent strings. The instrument sits upon a small four-footed wooden base. The mesh is solid, continuous, and clean, typical of a stylized game asset.
blind.from_above: From straight above it shows the circular flat top of the front pillar connected along a narrow spine to a scrolled finial, flanked on either side by the sloping triangular shoulders of the soundbox and four small protruding corner feet.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching roughly the shoulders of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 2 feet wide at the base.
